import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalDifferentialResidue

/-!
# Residues of parameter monomials

For a specified local parameter `t`, its residue map takes `t^n dt` to zero
unless `n = -1`, when the value is one. This verifies the local normalization
in every characteristic. `Chapter4ResidueParameterChange` proves the corresponding
normalization when the monomial and residue use distinct parameters.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- Negative powers of a parameter have zero residue except for its
logarithmic differential. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_inv_pow_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      ((algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) =
      if n = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
    (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ •
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)
  have hclear : t ^ (n + 1) • ω =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t) := by
    dsimp only [ω]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField (t ^ (n + 1)),
      map_pow, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_smul]
    exact pow_ne_zero _
      (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero)
  have hω : ω ∈ curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1) := by
    rw [mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul X hx t ht, hclear]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlocal : curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ⟨ω, hω⟩ =
      KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t := by
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    rw [curvePoleLocalDifferential_map]
    exact hclear
  change curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω = _
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx t ht n ⟨ω, hω⟩,
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply, hlocal]
  have he : KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t =
      curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht 1 := by simp
  rw [he, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, localTaylorCoefficient_one]

/-- Nonnegative parameter monomials are regular, hence have residue zero. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_pow_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) = 0 := by
  apply curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx t ht
  rw [← map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
  exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem _ ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- The fixed-parameter residue has the expected value on every integer
parameter monomial, in arbitrary characteristic. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_zpow_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℤ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) =
      if n = -1 then 1 else 0 := by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n =>
    rw [show Int.ofNat n = (n : ℤ) from rfl, _root_.zpow_natCast,
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_pow_smul, if_neg (by omega)]
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [zpow_negSucc, curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_inv_pow_smul]
    simp only [show Int.negSucc n = -1 ↔ n = 0 by omega]

end
end Hartshorne
